3. Check if the grounding tool returns valid bounding boxes for each phrase.
4. Compare the vertical position (y-coordinates) of the returned bounding boxes: upper lobe findings should localize to the upper lung fields, while lower lobe findings should localize to the lower lung fields/base.
5. Select the option whose grounded bounding box corresponds to the expected anatomical region for that lobe.
6.
